properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.acquire-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for acquiring a rate-limit permit for agent invocations.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.query-acquire-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for acquiring a rate-limit permit for per-query operations within a session.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.concurrency.max
properties.description: Maximum concurrent agent sessions. 0 disables concurrency limiting.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.token-bucket.permits-per-second
properties.description: Throughput rate limit in permits per second. 0 disables token-bucket limiting.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.token-bucket.burst-capacity
properties.description: Maximum burst capacity for the token bucket. 0 disables token-bucket limiting.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.sliding-window.max-actions
properties.description: Maximum actions allowed within the sliding window. 0 disables sliding-window limiting.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.sliding-window.window-seconds
properties.description: Duration of the sliding window in seconds.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.reaper.scan-interval
properties.description: Interval between session leak reaper scans.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.reaper.warn-threshold
properties.description: Session idle duration that triggers a leak warning.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.reaper.force-close-enabled
properties.description: Whether the reaper can force-close leaked sessions.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.reaper.force-close-threshold
properties.description: Session idle duration that triggers a forced close.

properties.name: casehub.platform.agent.gate.reaper.max-registry-age
properties.description: Maximum age for session registry entries before eviction.
